ruleDefinitions.name: Apache Spark Shell Command Injection - ProcessCreation
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects attempts to exploit an apache spark server via CVE-2014-6287 from a commandline perspective

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\bash$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*id\\ \\-Gn\\ \\`.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*id\\ \\-Gn\\ \\.*")))
